title: Tennis Tournaments
description: The grand stages of tennis — from the prestigious Grand Slams to the Masters and beyond

grand_slams.name: Wimbledon
grand_slams.description: The oldest and most prestigious tennis tournament in the world — played on grass courts where players must wear all white
traditions: Centre Court has a retractable roof
memorable_moments: Federer's 8th title in 2017 — the most by any man ever
Serena Williams' first Wimbledon title in 2002 — aged 20
Goran Ivanisevic winning as a wildcard in 2001 — Croatia's greatest sporting moment
fun_facts: The grass is cut to exactly 8mm before the tournament
Ball boys and girls are trained for months before the tournament
The famous queue for tickets is a British institution — fans camp overnight

grand_slams.name: US Open
grand_slams.location: USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center, New York, USA
grand_slams.description: The loudest and most vibrant Grand Slam — New York's energy makes it the most exciting event in tennis
traditions: Arthur Ashe Stadium — the world's largest tennis arena (capacity 23,771)
memorable_moments: Serena Williams' dominance — won 6 US Open titles across three decades
Carlos Alcaraz winning in 2022 aged 19 — becoming world No. 1 at the same time
Naomi Osaka's emotional victory in 2018 — defeating Serena Williams in a controversial final
fun_facts: The US Open was the first Grand Slam to offer equal prize money to men and women — since 1973!
Arthur Ashe Stadium has a retractable roof — added in 2016

grand_slams.name: French Open (Roland Garros)
grand_slams.description: The only Grand Slam played on clay — the slowest surface that rewards endurance, patience and heavy topspin
traditions: Named after French World War I flying ace Roland Garros
The famous red clay from Beaumont-sur-Sarthe
Players must win 5 sets in the men's draw — the most demanding Grand Slam

men_most_titles.fun_fact: The King of Clay — lost only 3 matches at Roland Garros in 19 years

memorable_moments: Nadal's 14th title in 2022 — the most wins at any single Grand Slam in history
Iga Swiatek's reign — won 4 French Opens in 5 years from 2020
Gustavo Kuerten's first title in 1997 as a massive underdog — drew a heart on the court to celebrate
fun_facts: Clay slows the ball down — points last much longer than on grass or hard courts
Roland Garros added a roof to Court Philippe-Chatrier in 2020
The tournament uses over 45,000 kg of clay per court

grand_slams.name: Australian Open
grand_slams.description: The first Grand Slam of the year — known for extreme heat and a passionate Australian crowd
traditions: Can hit temperatures of 45 degrees — extreme heat policy pauses play in very hot weather
A Grand Slam for the whole family — very accessible

men_most_titles.fun_fact: Djokovic has won the Australian Open more than any other player in history — 10 titles

fun_facts: Australia is in the Southern Hemisphere, so January is summer — players play in scorching heat
Roof closes when temperature exceeds 35 degrees under the Extreme Heat Policy

atp_masters.title: ATP Masters 1000
atp_masters.description: The biggest tournaments below Grand Slams — 9 events worldwide

events.name: Monte Carlo Masters
events.fun_fact: Played on the French Riviera — one of the most beautiful venues in sport

events.name: Italian Open (Rome Masters)
events.fun_fact: Played at the Foro Italico — Fascist-era statues surround the courts

events.name: Paris Masters
events.fun_fact: Last Masters before the ATP Finals — crucial for year-end rankings

wta_events.title: WTA Tour — Women's Tennis
wta_events.description: The Women's Tennis Association runs the top women's circuit

slams_dominated_by.description: Greatest women's player ever — dominated two decades of tennis
Golden Slam winner — only player to win all 4 Slams plus Olympic gold in one year (1988)
All-time Wimbledon record holder — 9 titles at the All England Club
Current world No. 1 — dominant on clay but won multiple hard court slams too
Retired at world No. 1 aged 25 — won Wimbledon, Roland Garros and Australian Open
Won the 2023 US Open — the next generation's leading star

atp_finals.name: Nitto ATP Finals
atp_finals.description: Year-end championship for the top 8 players of the season
